start: Owner; the gym is online and its server has the reminders part

steps.action: Open 'Messages & offers' and tap the tab 'Reminders'
user_sees: A card 'Automatic reminders': 'Members with the MettleUp app get these on their phone at 9:30 am, never more than one a day. Their phone sets them, so they cost nothing. Members can turn them off in the app.'
'<k> of <n> on · the usual ones' until someone changes them
One row per reminder with a switch, and a days box where it has days
must_not: 'Only the owner can change these.' shown to the owner

steps.action: Switch one reminder off and change the days of another
user_sees: Buttons 'Save changes' and 'Undo changes' appear live
must_not: The change taking effect before saving

user_sees: 'Saving…', then the note "Saved. Members' phones pick this up the next time they open MettleUp."
'· last changed by <owner's name>' on the top card
must_not: The switches jumping back to the old values
Members getting the switched-off reminder after they next open the app

start: Owner follows a link straight to the address /messages/reminders

user_sees: 'Messages & offers' with the tab 'Reminders' picked and the reminders list

start: Reminders tab with wrong input, or a gym that cannot use it yet

steps.action: Type letters or a number outside the range in a days box of a reminder that is on
user_sees: A red line under that row; 'Save changes' greyed
must_not: The error shown for a reminder that is switched off

steps.action: Open the tab on a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Automatic reminders need your gym online' with a line pointing to Settings → Staff & sign-in

steps.action: Open the tab on a gym whose server lacks this part
user_sees: 'Automatic reminders are not switched on for your gym yet.'
'Until then, members with the MettleUp app get the usual ones: plan ends in 7 and 3 days, ends today, plan ended, welcome, and workout offer days added.'

steps.action: Save while the internet is off
user_sees: A red message; the changes stay on screen to try again

start: Reminders tab, the usual settings saved

steps.action: Change two rows, then tap 'Undo changes'
user_sees: Both rows back to the saved values; 'Save changes' greyed again

steps.action: Switch a reminder on, save, then off, save
user_sees: '<k> of <n> on' goes up, then down; 'last changed by' stays
must_not: The count on the card differing from the switches

steps.action: Change something and leave the page without saving
user_sees: The page leaves; on coming back the saved values show

start: Owner reading what members will get

steps.action: Read the top card and each row
user_sees: That members get at most one a day at 9:30 am and can turn them off in their app
must_not: A reminder going to a member who turned reminders off
A 'we miss you' reminder that reads as an offer

start: Front desk signed in; a member asks why they got a reminder

steps.action: Open 'Workout offer' from the menu and tap the tab 'Reminders'
user_sees: Title 'Automatic reminders' with 'What members get on their phone by themselves'
The same list as the owner, with 'Only the owner can change these.'
'<k> of <n> on' and who last changed them

start: Front desk on the Reminders tab

steps.action: Tap a switch or a days box
user_sees: Nothing changes: every switch and box is greyed
must_not: A switch that moves and looks saved
A change sent to the server

start: Front desk has the tab open while the owner saves a change on another device

user_sees: The old values until the tab is opened again (there is no refresh by itself)
must_not: A mix of old and new values

steps.action: Leave and open the tab again
user_sees: The owner's new values and '· last changed by <owner's name>'
must_not: '· the usual ones' after a change was saved
